payload.name: Measured native campaign forest
payload.limitations: Harmless native fixture behavior only. Benign whole-file saves and destructive operations can be observationally indistinguishable. No real-world ransomware coverage claim.

training.selection_policy: Maximize onset-qualified tuning campaign recall at a cutoff immediately above the largest benign tuning session maximum; tie-break fewer false alerts, then smaller mean onset-to-alert event delay among detected tuning campaigns, then fewer tree nodes.
training.cutoff_policy: After selecting one estimator, use the next representable float above the largest benign calibration session maximum. Clip at1 only at the score ceiling, explicitly reporting an unattainable zero-alert budget. Never adjust after opening test.

evaluation.limitations: Harmless native fixture behavior only. Benign whole-file saves and destructive operations can be observationally indistinguishable. No real-world ransomware coverage claim.
